cards.back:
To look at something for a long time in wonder.
Bahasa Indonesia: memandang takjub
Example: We gazed at the stars until the sky turned grey.
cards.say: gaze. To look at something for a long time in wonder. We gazed at the stars until the sky turned grey.

cards.back:
To see something for a very short time.
Bahasa Indonesia: sekilas melihat
Example: I glimpsed a deer between the trees.
cards.say: glimpse. To see something for a very short time. I glimpsed a deer between the trees.

cards.back:
To run quickly for a short distance.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlari kencang
Example: The children dashed across the playground when the bell rang.
cards.say: dash. To run quickly for a short distance. The children dashed across the playground when the bell rang.

cards.back:
To walk quietly on the tips of your toes.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjingkat
Example: He tiptoed past the sleeping baby so he would not wake her.
cards.say: tiptoe. To walk quietly on the tips of your toes. He tiptoed past the sleeping baby so he would not wake her.

cards.back:
To trip and nearly tumble over while walking.
Bahasa Indonesia: tersandung
Example: She stumbled on a loose stone and dropped her books.
cards.say: stumble. To trip and nearly tumble over while walking. She stumbled on a loose stone and dropped her books.

cards.back:
To swallow quickly in large amounts.
Bahasa Indonesia: menenggak
Example: He gulped down a glass of water after the race.
cards.say: gulp. To swallow quickly in large amounts. He gulped down a glass of water after the race.

cards.back:
To eat a little at a time with small bites.
Bahasa Indonesia: makan sedikit-sedikit
Example: The rabbit nibbled a carrot behind the hutch.
cards.say: nibble. To eat a little at a time with small bites. The rabbit nibbled a carrot behind the hutch.

cards.back:
To look at someone in an angry way.
Bahasa Indonesia: menatap tajam
Example: The referee glared at the player who pushed the other boy.
cards.say: glare. To look at someone in an angry way. The referee glared at the player who pushed the other boy.

cards.back:
In a soft and careful way.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan lembut
Example: She gently placed the sleeping kitten in the basket.
cards.say: gently. In a soft and careful way. She gently placed the sleeping kitten in the basket.

cards.back:
Very fast.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan cepat
Example: The deer ran swiftly through the tall grass towards the trees.
cards.say: swiftly. Very fast. The deer ran swiftly through the tall grass towards the trees.

cards.back:
With great interest and excitement.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan penuh semangat
Example: The class eagerly opened the box of new books.
cards.say: eagerly. With great interest and excitement. The class eagerly opened the box of new books.

cards.back:
In a worried way.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan gugup
Example: He nervously tapped his pencil while waiting for the result.
cards.say: nervously. In a worried way. He nervously tapped his pencil while waiting for the result.

cards.back:
With attention so as not to make a mistake.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan hati-hati
Example: Carry the soup carefully, because the bowl is very hot.
cards.say: carefully. With attention so as not to make a mistake. Carry the soup carefully, because the bowl is very hot.

cards.back:
Without making any sound.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan senyap
Example: The cat crept silently towards the bird on the fence.
cards.say: silently. Without making any sound. The cat crept silently towards the bird on the fence.

cards.back:
In a strong, wild or angry way.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan ganas
Example: The wind blew fiercely and bent the young trees.
cards.say: fiercely. In a strong, wild or angry way. The wind blew fiercely and bent the young trees.

cards.back:
With a feeling of great pleasure in what you have done.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan bangga
Example: She proudly showed her painting to the whole class.
cards.say: proudly. With a feeling of great pleasure in what you have done. She proudly showed her painting to the whole class.

cards.back:
To move or take something quickly.
Bahasa Indonesia: membawa dengan cepat
Example: The waiter whisked the empty plates off the table.
cards.say: whisk. To move or take something quickly. The waiter whisked the empty plates off the table.

cards.back:
To jump or drop suddenly into something.
Bahasa Indonesia: terjun
Example: The divers plunged into the clear blue water.
cards.say: plunge. To jump or drop suddenly into something. The divers plunged into the clear blue water.

cards.back:
To walk slowly with heavy steps because you are tired.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan dengan susah payah
Example: We trudged home through the thick mud after the match.
cards.say: trudge. To walk slowly with heavy steps because you are tired. We trudged home through the thick mud after the match.

cards.back:
To move smoothly and quietly.
Bahasa Indonesia: meluncur
Example: The swan glided across the calm lake at sunrise.
cards.say: glide. To move smoothly and quietly. The swan glided across the calm lake at sunrise.

cards.back:
To pause before doing something because you are not sure.
Bahasa Indonesia: ragu-ragu
Example: Do not hesitate to ask the teacher if you need help.
cards.say: hesitate. To pause before doing something because you are not sure. Do not hesitate to ask the teacher if you need help.
